data.body: INSTRUMENT CHANGES. (1) runs_gstack.json completed from 19 to all 40 campaign plans by derivation from runs_wave4.json; every derivation rule (code_worktree, verified_at_sha<-code_ref, pinned_plan_source<-plan_doc, pinned_plan_sha256 recomputed) validated against the 19 pre-existing sourced rows before any row was written. desc_chars deliberately omitted as non-derivable; all consumers read it via .get() and no Wave-4 plan carries it in any manifest. (2) Variant-tag dispatch implemented for every arm: rebar w3_batch.sh/w3_rebar_run.py --variant, gstack GSTACK_VARIANT, sp/sp5 SP_VARIANT, ce needed nothing (its --rep already took explicit labels, built for the d1r bridge). _fresh_tag now admits an arm only if it declares runner_variant, so an arm cannot be handed a tag its runner cannot write. (3) extract.py widened to six arms (sp5 added) with a draw axis on every arm, backed by campaign.census rather than reconstructed filenames. (4) ballot.py builds six-arm ballots per draw; legacy four-arm draw-1 shape still rebuilds byte-identically for all 40 plans. (5) New harness/merge_ballot.py produces merged per-plan n=3 ballots. (6) adjudicate.py now verifies the ballot the judges declared, exit 3 on mismatch.
